scope: Supervised make-head adaptation only; general encoders and family head frozen. Known new errors become TRAIN. Public validation chooses candidate. Reused public test is development regression, not independent accuracy.
selection: Do not lower confidence gates by hand. Require validation routed precision >= baseline - .002, correct confirmations >= baseline on both normal and phone views; raw top1 >= baseline - .005. Require all original new TRAIN corrections accepted correctly. No further candidate searches after these two.
